description: This file is a shell script used for managing the ciscoconnect service, including starting, stopping, restarting, and processing guest network configurations. It includes sourcing external scripts and setting system events related to network and service management.

methods.name: cc_preproc
methods.description: Preprocesses and sets guest network parameters using psmcli and sysevent.

methods.name: start_guestnet
methods.description: Starts the guest network by setting the ipv4-up sysevent and updating guest status.

methods.name: stop_guestnet
methods.description: Stops the guest network, triggers firewall restart, and updates guest status.

methods.name: service_init
methods.description: Initializes the service, currently just outputs a blank line.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Starts the ciscoconnect service and updates its status.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the ciscoconnect service and updates its status.

methods.name: service_restart
methods.description: Restarts the ciscoconnect service by stopping and then starting it.
